name: PayLexer
author: PayLexer

sections.description:
If you want to accept payments through Stripe, PayPal, or any other gateway inside WooCommerce, WP Travel Engine, or your favorite WordPress plugin, but your plugin doesn’t support it, PayLexer connects them for you.

Most WordPress plugins only work with a handful of payment gateways. If the one you want isn’t on that list, you’re stuck. You either switch plugins, hire a developer to build a custom connection, or just make do with whatever your plugin supports.

PayLexer adds your chosen gateway directly inside your existing checkout flow. Your customers stay in the same checkout process they already know. Nothing changes for them except that they have more ways to pay.

No coding. No developer. No switching plugins. You install PayLexer, connect your gateway, and you’re ready to accept payments in less than 7 minutes.

PayLexer does not process or store payments. Every transaction goes directly through the gateway you choose.

Getting Started with PayLexer in Less than 7 Minutes | Supported Payment Gateways | Compatible Plugins | Customer Support | Documentation

Key Features

  • 43 payment gateways across global, regional, and local markets
  • Works inside your existing checkout flow, not a replacement
  • Your credentials are stored in an encrypted vault. We cannot access them. Nobody can.
  • Free for up to 5 WordPress sites. Need more? Just ask.
  • New gateways and plugin integrations added every month

Supported Payment Gateways

PayLexer currently supports 43 payment gateways. New ones are added every month.

  • Stripe – Global
  • PayPal – Global
  • Airwallex – Global
  • Braintree – Global

  • Adyen – Global (North America, Europe, Latin America, Asia-Pacific, Middle East)

Looking for a different gateway? Request it here. Your request helps us decide what gets added next.

Compatible Plugins

PayLexer currently works with four major WordPress plugins.

  • WooCommerce
  • WP Travel Engine
  • Fluent Cart
  • Easy Digital Downloads

You do not need to switch or reconfigure anything. Simply install PayLexer, connect your account, and every supported gateway becomes available inside your existing plugin.

We regularly add support for new WordPress plugins. If your preferred plugin is not supported yet, you can submit a plugin request.

Full documentation available at paylexer.com

External Services

PayLexer is a WordPress plugin that links your WordPress store to the PayLexer platform, a cloud-based service. It connects your store’s checkout to your chosen payment gateway. The plugin and the PayLexer platform do not process payments. Every transaction is handled directly by the gateway you choose. A PayLexer account is required for the plugin to work.

To do that, the plugin communicates with these PayLexer services:

  1. Payment service (https://paylexer.com) — Initiates and tracks payment requests and keeps your gateway settings in sync. Sends order details and customer billing information needed to complete the payment, including name, email, address, and phone, along with your site URL and account credentials.

  2. Checkout (https://checkout.paylexer.com) — Shows your customer the secure payment screen. Receives only a reference to the payment being made. No personal data is sent here.

  3. App (https://app.paylexer.com) — Loads the payment-method logo images shown at checkout and in the settings, and provides admin links to your PayLexer dashboard. No order or customer data is sent here.

The plugin also sets one first-party cookie, “paylexer_session_id”, to link a guest’s checkout to their payment. It stores a random ID only, with no personal data.

Your use of these services is subject to the PayLexer Terms of Service (https://paylexer.com/terms) and Privacy Policy (https://paylexer.com/privacy-policy).

Privacy Policy

PayLexer processes payment information as necessary to complete transactions. The plugin:

  • Does not store credit card or sensitive payment data
  • Transmits payment data securely to payment providers
  • Stores order references and transaction IDs for order management
  • May send customer email and order information to PayLexer services
  • Follows WordPress privacy and data protection guidelines

For complete privacy information, visit paylexer.com/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation:

  1. Log in to your WordPress dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “PayLexer”
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”

Manual Installation:

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Log in to your WordPress dashboard
  3. Navigate to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  4. Choose the downloaded zip file and click “Install Now”
  5. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu

Requirements:

  • WordPress 5.9 or higher
  • PHP 8.1 or higher
  • At least one supported platform: WooCommerce, WP Travel Engine, Fluent Cart, or Easy Digital Downloads
  • SSL certificate (HTTPS) recommended for production
sections.faq:
Is PayLexer free to use?

Yes. PayLexer is free to use. You can connect up to 5 websites at no cost. No credit card required.

Do I need a developer to set up PayLexer?

No. You sign up, add your website, and connect the gateway you want to use. The setup takes less than 7 minutes.

Will my existing checkout flow change?

No. PayLexer adds the gateway inside your existing checkout. Your customers go through the same process they always have. They just have more ways to pay.

What if my payment gateway is not supported yet?

We add new gateways every month. If you don’t see the one you need, you can request it here. Your request helps us decide what gets added next.

Will PayLexer work with my existing WordPress setup?

Yes. Your existing plugin and setup stay exactly as they are. PayLexer adds gateway options on top of what you already have.

Does PayLexer process or store my payments?

No. Every payment goes directly through the gateway you choose. PayLexer never touches the transaction.

How safe are my payment gateway credentials?

Your credentials are stored in an encrypted vault. We cannot access them. Nobody can.

What happens when new gateways or plugins are added?

Nothing changes on your end. New gateways and plugins appear in your dashboard automatically. You connect them when you’re ready.
